scope: Four narrow official referrals for remaining WDVA overview topics; not complete benefit, eligibility or availability coverage. Import verification records before copy.

records.title: Driver license and vehicle help
records.summary: Check Wisconsin DMV options for a Veteran license or ID marker, military plates, parking permits and military driving experience.
records.caveat: WDVA must confirm eligibility for the Veteran marker. Each plate, permit and CDL option has separate rules. Military service does not automatically qualify you.
records.action: Open Wisconsin DMV's Military veterans page and follow the instructions for the license, plate or permit you need; confirm Veteran-marker eligibility with WDVA before applying at DMV.
records.label: Check military and veteran DMV options
records.claim: WisDOT provides a current military/veteran hub linking Veteran-identifier certification, special plate rules, disability parking and military CDL options. The marker requires WDVA eligibility review before DMV application. National Guard plates confer no special parking privileges.
records.population: All four may use the public DMV route for a relevant vehicle or license question; individual military/veteran products have separate eligibility.
records.excluded: Family connection, military service or a state choice in this app alone does not establish entitlement to a marker, special plate, disability parking or CDL waiver. DMV licensing is separate from DSPS occupational licensing.
records.placement: Optional DMV/vehicle detail; preserve the primary moving answer and the maximum-three local-help block. Do not append a fourth housing help row.
records.boundary: Special plates page currently reports its online service unavailable. Refer to current official instructions; do not promise online ordering works. CDL time window requires the separate correction record.
records.band: Condition-triggered need or planning inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.

records.title: Explore long-term nursing care
records.summary: Wisconsin Veterans Homes provide skilled nursing and long-term care for eligible veterans and certain family members.
records.caveat: Ask admissions about service or family eligibility, care needs, costs and available beds. These are care homes, not temporary housing.
records.action: Open the Wisconsin Veterans Homes site, choose a home, and contact admissions about eligibility, care needs, costs and availability; use its Admissions Inquiry or WDVA4000 application instructions if appropriate.
records.label: Explore Wisconsin Veterans Homes
records.claim: WDVA links to its Homes site, which identifies skilled nursing homes and home-specific admissions processes. Official home pages describe veteran, spouse/surviving-spouse and qualifying parent categories and admission priorities. The current WDVA4006 checklist lists service, relationship, health and insurance documentation.
records.population: ALREADY SEPARATED and qualifying SPOUSE/FAMILY applicants; GUARD/RESERVE only if independently meeting the applicable veteran or family admission criteria. Other visitors may use this public route on behalf of a qualifying relative.
records.excluded: This does not establish admissions eligibility for every currently serving member, drilling Reservist, spouse or dependent child. It is not a VHRP homeless-housing placement or a guarantee of free care.
records.placement: Optional health/family help, separate from VHRP or household housing routes.
records.boundary: No applicant or care decision was evaluated; no form was submitted. Official pages accept out-of-state applications but describe residency priorities; no runtime residency threshold or admission promise is proposed.
records.band: Condition-triggered need or planning inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.

records.title: Plan a Wisconsin veterans cemetery burial
records.summary: Use WDVA's cemetery page to check eligibility and pre-register, or ask a funeral director to contact the cemetery when arranging a burial.
records.caveat: Veteran and eligible-family rules and fees differ. Pre-registration checks eligibility; it does not by itself reserve a gravesite or request funeral honors.
records.action: Use WDVA's Wisconsin Veteran Memorial Cemeteries page to contact a cemetery about eligibility and fees and find MyWisVets pre-registration instructions; for a burial now, ask the funeral director to contact the cemetery.
records.label: Check cemetery eligibility and arrangements
records.claim: WDVA identifies state cemetery locations, veteran/family eligibility, pre-registration via MyWisVets or form2111, separate gravesite assignment rules and funeral-director scheduling. Family fees and other charges differ from eligible veteran interment.
records.population: All four may plan or ask on behalf of an eligible veteran or family member; burial eligibility is based on the deceased veteran/service and family rules, not on the person browsing.
records.excluded: Current Guard/Reserve service alone does not establish cemetery eligibility, and being a spouse or relative alone does not establish eligibility for every family member. No particular gravesite, eligibility result or complete funeral payment is promised.
records.placement: Optional benefits/family planning detail; separate from military funeral honors.
records.boundary: The official page documents limited exceptions to advance reservations. The statement is specifically that pre-registration by itself does not reserve a site. No dollar figure or burial-eligibility threshold is copied.
records.band: Condition-triggered need or planning inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.

records.title: Arrange military funeral honors
records.summary: For a funeral in Wisconsin, ask the funeral director or WDVA Honors Coordination Office how to request military funeral honors.
records.caveat: Qualifying military service and discharge rules apply. Honors are a separate request from cemetery burial and do not pay other funeral expenses.
records.action: Use WDVA's Military Funeral Honors page to ask the funeral director or Honors Coordination Office about eligibility and submitting WDVA Form2800 for honors in Wisconsin.
records.label: Check military funeral honors
records.claim: WDVA coordinates funeral honors, provides an eligibility-review route and a family/funeral-director request process. Current form2800 expressly covers honors conducted in Wisconsin and describes the ceremony request, rather than cemetery interment or a funeral-expense payment.
records.population: All four may seek information or arrange honors on behalf of a qualifying deceased service member or veteran; service and discharge eligibility apply to the deceased.
records.excluded: An eligible family member for cemetery burial does not automatically qualify for military funeral honors through that relationship. This is not a cash burial allowance or an automatic accompaniment to cemetery registration.
records.placement: Optional benefits/family planning detail, distinct from cemetery burial.
records.boundary: No personal identifiers are collected in Transition OPS. No ceremony composition or availability is guaranteed. No phone number was copied.
records.band: Condition-triggered need or planning inquiry; no fixed separation band or day-offset.
